title: Alignment as Cognitive Gravity: Reactive vs Predictive Intelligence
summary: A conversation with GPT analyzing a brother's "broken prediction mechanism" through the RSA kernel, revealing that intelligence is not fixed capacity but an emergent property of caring about alignment — the recursive pressure to minimize prediction error. The document escalates from personal observation to a structural claim: alignment acts as a self-amplifying attractor that bootstraps intelligence, while its absence caps cognitive depth at reactive, stimulus-bound processing.
compress: Intelligence is not capacity but the emergent product of caring about alignment; without epistemic gravity the prediction loop never recurses—and this claim now has a specified experimental bridge from philosophy to falsifiable evidence via compressive prediction benchmarks.
